course.name: Option Alpha
course.tagline: An options trading education and automation platform founded by Kirk Du Plessis in 2010.
course.about: Option Alpha is an options trading education and automation platform founded by Kirk Du Plessis in 2010, a former investment banker and stock analyst. It combines a three-tiered course system (beginner through advanced) with tools for strategy backtesting and automated trade management, usable with several supported brokers.

formats.label: Backtesting engine
formats.description: Test options strategies against historical data.

formats.label: Automated trading bots
formats.description: Rule-based position entry, management and exits.

pricing.name: Free (broker-linked)
pricing.billing_note: Free with a qualifying Tradier or TradeStation account (minimum balance requirements apply).

pricing.name: Pro (Annual)
pricing.billing_note: Billed annually. Trade with any broker, 50 bots, $100k limit per bot, unlimited backtesting.
